AnVIL provides workshops and demos at several genomics-focused events, including conferences such as the American Society of Human Genetics Annual Meeting, the Galaxy and Bioconductor Community Conference, and various Cold Spring Harbor Lab meetings.

Check out the [AnVIL Events Page](https://anvilproject.org/events) for the most up to date list of events.
